title: Specialist - PMO & Client Intelligence
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Role Summary
  
We are seeking a PMO Specialist to support the Hong Kong Growth Programme. You will be responsible for establishing program governance, managing key deliverables, and coordinating with senior stakeholders to drive our client growth strategy. This strategic role involves implementing standardized processes for our Priority Client and High Value Target (HVT) programmes, ensuring the successful delivery of intelligence-led initiatives. You will serve as a key partner to the Hong Kong Lead, providing critical programme support and actionable insights to guide strategic decisions.
  
Duties & Responsibilities
  

* Program Governance: Design and embed governance frameworks, delivery standards, and reporting templates to standardize the execution of the Hong Kong Growth Programme.
* Stakeholder Coordination & Reporting: Establish and manage reporting cadences, engagement plans, and approval checkpoints aligned with strategic priorities. Serve as the central point of contact for cross-business line coordination.
* Deliverable Management: Own and execute the creation of key monthly deliverables.
* Data & Dashboard Administration: Oversee the central database and dashboards for the growth programme, ensuring data hygiene, update latency, and Business Line input rates are tracked and reported to the Hong Kong Lead.
* Intelligence to Action: Partner with the Hong Kong Lead to translate intelligence into action by preparing materials for workshops, including pre-reads, stakeholder maps, and opportunity heatmaps.

**Sounds like you? To apply you need to have:**  

* 5-7+ years of progressive experience in a PMO, program coordination, or business management role.
* Proven experience working within a structured PMO or programme environment.
* Demonstrated success managing deliverables and coordinating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

Key Skills & Expertise
  

* Core Expertise: Program Governance, Stakeholder Management, Process Standardization, and Executive-level Communication.
* Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile & Hybrid Delivery Models, Process Improvement Methodologies.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in SharePoint, Advanced MS Excel, and PowerPoint is required. Experience with Power BI and familiarity with AI Tools is a plus.
* Leadership: Strong ability to influence diverse audiences, promote collaboration, and facilitate change management across business units. Proven ability to develop concise reports and presentations for senior leadership discussions.

**What we can do for you:**  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay, and benefits package
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Associate Project Manager to support strategic initiatives, project governance, and business execution. This role will enable disciplined planning, coordination, reporting, and follow-through across priority initiatives, helping ensure business commitments are tracked, risks are surfaced, and outcomes are delivered with clarity and accountability. The ideal candidate will be comfortable coordinating with stakeholders, managing multiple priorities, supporting governance routines, preparing meaningful business updates, and driving action-oriented follow-through that improves visibility, alignment, and operational effectiveness.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Project Management & Coordination
  + Support planning, coordination, governance, and delivery tracking for strategic projects, transformation initiatives, and operational priorities aligned to business objectives
  + Maintain project plans, milestones, deliverables, dependency trackers, risk logs, action registers, and status reporting to enable disciplined execution
  + Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to monitor progress, manage dependencies, identify risks, and escalate issues requiring timely attention
  + Support project reviews, governance forums, and leadership discussions by documenting decisions, actions, owners, and follow-ups through closure
  + Prepare dashboards, business updates, presentations, and governance materials that communicate project health, progress, risks, and outcomes clearly
* Strategy Execution, Governance & Business Operations
  + Support execution of strategic priorities and business objectives through structured governance, performance tracking, and operational follow-through
  + Enable informed decision-making by consolidating business updates, performance insights, and reporting inputs into clear, action-oriented materials
  + Track milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and performance indicators to strengthen accountability and delivery visibility
  + Improve governance routines, reporting mechanisms, and operating rhythms to enhance transparency, consistency, and execution discipline
  + Help translate business priorities into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and sustainable execution routines
  + Support continuous improvement and operational efficiency through data-informed problem solving, process simplification, and disciplined follow-up
  + Foster cross-functional alignment and stakeholder engagement to accelerate execution, remove barriers, and achieve business objectives
  + Handle sensitive project, business, and leadership-related information with professionalism, discretion, and appropriate confidentiality
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of experience in project management, PMO, business operations, governance, or strategic execution roles
* Experience using project management or workflow tracking tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, Planner, or similar platforms
* Solid experience preparing project status updates, governance materials, business reviews, dashboards, scorecards, and leadership-ready reporting
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, and Alteryx
* Demonstrated ability to support cross-functional initiatives by tracking milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, actions, and stakeholder commitments
* Demonstrated solid communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Project management certification or equivalent
* Experience in healthcare, insurance, operations, shared services, or other highly regulated business environments
* Experience supporting executive-level reviews, governance forums, leadership updates, or business performance discussions
* Experience partnering with cross-functional teams across operations, technology, analytics, finance, or business leadership
* Exposure to transformation programs, operating model improvements, process simplification, or continuous improvement initiatives
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or structured problem-solving methodologies
* Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous business needs into structured plans, milestones, trackers, and actionable reporting
* Demonstrated solid storytelling and presentation skills with the ability to translate data, risks, progress, and outcomes into concise business insights

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Sr. Technical Project Manager
description:
**Date de publication :** Oct 14, 2026, 12:00AM
  
About usJoin us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
About the role
  
Job Purpose
  
  
The Senior Technical Project Manager will lead and coordinate the Evolution Platform Operations and Move2Scale program, ensuring stable day-to-day platform operations while driving the transition, industrialization, automation, and scaling of services across environments. The role will act as the single point of coordination for technical delivery, operational readiness, risks, dependencies, milestones, and transformation activities.
  
  
Experience & Qualifications
  
  
**Essential:**  

* 10+ years of experience in IT/technology delivery.
* 8+ years in Technical Project Management / Program Management.
* Proven experience managing large-scale infrastructure, cloud, platform or transformation programs.
* Experience managing technical teams across multiple disciplines.
* Strong understanding of Cloud, DevOps, Automation and Operations.
* Experience with production environments and service transition.
* Strong experience in risk, dependency and stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

**Preferred:**  

* PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe / Scrum certification.
* ITIL certification.

About you
  
  
**Mission:**  
**Key mission areas:**  

* Ensure stable, reliable and efficient Evolution Platform operations.
* Lead Move2Scale initiatives from planning through implementation and transition to operations.
* Drive automation, standardization and industrialization of platform operations.
* Coordinate multiple technical teams and suppliers across the delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure that new capabilities are production-ready, supportable and aligned with operational standards.
* Proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies and technical debt.
* Establish transparent program governance, KPIs and executive reporting.
* Continuously improve platform availability, resilience, performance, security and operational efficiency.

**Governance & Stakeholder Management:**  

* Act as the primary coordination point between technical and business stakeholders.
* Conduct regular steering committees and governance reviews.
* Provide concise executive-level reporting on status, risks, issues and dependencies.
* Escalate critical risks and decisions in a timely manner.
* Drive decision-making across teams where ownership is distributed.

Technical Project & Program Management
  
  

* Lead complex technical projects across Evolution Platform and Move2Scale.
* Define scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables and success criteria.
* Build and maintain integrated project/program plans.
* Manage dependencies across Cloud, Network, DevOps, Automation, Security, Application and Operations teams.
* Drive execution through Agile/Scrum/SAFe methodologies where applicable.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability across workstreams.

Technical PM – Experience & Competencies
  
  

* Proven experience in technical project/program management with strong exposure to Cloud, Platform Engineering, DevOps and IT Operations.
* Demonstrated experience in managing complex technology transformation, migration, modernization and scale-up programs across multiple technical teams.
* Experience managing production platform operations, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Capacity, Availability and Service Management processes.
* Proven experience in managing service transition and operational readiness, ensuring smooth movement of solutions from project delivery into BAU operations.
* Experience leading migration waves, cutover planning, go-live activities, rollback planning and post-production stabilization.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional technical teams comprising Cloud, DevOps, Network, Security, Application, Architecture and Operations specialists.
* Strong experience in Agile/Scrum/SAFe methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, PI planning, dependency management and delivery tracking using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to establish and manage program governance, including milestones, KPIs, technical risks, dependencies, decisions and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to identify technical and operational risks early, develop mitigation/contingency strategies and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Experience in managing technical dependencies across multiple projects, platforms, suppliers and geographically distributed teams.
* Prior experience in technical estimation, resource planning, capacity planning, roadmap development and delivery planning for complex technology initiatives.
* Experience in preparing technical proposals, delivery approaches, effort estimates, business cases and transformation roadmaps.
* Strong experience in stakeholder management, with the ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Product, Business and Senior Management.
* Ability to translate business objectives into technical delivery plans, measurable outcomes and actionable workstreams.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and KPIs to identify operational improvement opportunities, measure program performance and support management decisions.
* Strong understanding of production readiness, operational acceptance criteria, monitoring, support models, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and leadership skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
What we offer
  
  

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.

title: Project Manager
description:

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you interested in launching the next generation of Amazon sites in India? Do you want to be part of the ongoing growth and expansion of Amazon’s infrastructure? The IN-Engineering Services Team is seeking an experienced Amazon Operator or Program Manager to join the IN-Launch Team to support the expansion of operation sites in India. The Launch Program Manager is a key player in the end-to-end delivery of the complex challenge of launching new buildings, driving improvements and standards to enable new buildings to achieve benchmark rates while ramping to meet network capacity. In this role, you will influence a team comprising of General Managers, Senior Operations Managers, Operation Managers, Change Ops manager, Area Managers, Project Managers, Process SMEs, Design Engineers, Real Estate, RME, CP as well as representatives of various key stakeholder teams including Supply Chain & Transportation, WHS, WFS, L&D, ICQA, EHS, Legal, L&P, ER, Finance and many others. This role calls for an individual who is operationally knowledgeable, structured, confident and professionally and socially adept to earn credibility and trust with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization, keeping an open mind, sense of humor, multi-tasking, ability to manage and deal with constant change, a drive-and-ambition and ability to deal with ambiguity will help you remain innovative in our culture  
In order to be successful in this position, you need to be comfortable interfacing and driving various BU’s launches, including INFC, IXD/RC, DRCC, SDC, SC, AMZL, GSF, QC & 3P launches for respective BU’s. This will be an exciting opportunity for you if you possess a high level of autonomy and integrity while managing a variety of job responsibilities. You will be part of a high functioning team that is interconnected and supportive of each other to help complete multiple, complex and high capital projects simultaneously.
  
The individual will be responsible for entire region (IN Network Operate in 3 Regions, “North & East”, “South & Central” and “West”). The role will be based out of 3 regions with up to 50% of time on job travel across states. This is the fusion of strategical as well as tactical during full cycle of launch.  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The successful candidate:  

* Is structured and organized, to plan the use of resource to meet deadlines.
* Has strong interpersonal skills, to motivate and lead core teams working on launch.
* Has strong communication skills to build relationships and identify with stakeholders across the organization.
* Is able to use their initiative and make decisions under pressure.

* Should be able to ask “Why” and request details in regards to the impact of any changes requested by different teams.
* Is capable of taking accountability while providing status, asking for help, and immediately escalating issues and problems as necessary.
* Should be able to coordinate activities while onsite as well as from the office.
* Possesses a broad technical background and has the ability to “roll up their sleeves” and jump in to support, along with Coordinating the activities of different functions and act as the anchor or single point of contact for the launch process

  
  
A day in the life  

* End-to-End project coordination, managing multiple stakeholders to ensure all Road to Launch tasks are completed as per program
* Managing Launch calls with regional teams, documenting key actionable and ensure closure of key points.
* Ensuring support function 4M cycle completion as per process.
* Ensuring all function signage cycle completion as per process.
* Ensure 5S marking BOQ closure as per site requirement.
* Coordinate with RE for site selection process as per SLA and POR NBD with SIM mechanism in place.
* Ensure TAX registration process and support seller onboarding process as per Launch tenets.
* Ensuring overall site readiness through thorough composite reviews and effective communication on in-flight changes
* Post launch lessons learned sessions to drive year-on-year improvements
* Managing continuous improvement in 4M, Playbook, Signages and launch mechanism.

  
About the team  
Our team is focused on driving programmatic excellence across Amazon, delivering results that matter to customers and the business. We operate in a collaborative environment where new ideas are welcomed and simplification is a priority. As we continue to grow, we are investing in automation, data-driven planning, and scalable mechanisms that raise the bar on how we deliver. ------------------------

* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**The Role:**

* Lead the design team to produce detailed designs for all workstreams.
* Leading electrical connection designs up to 400 kV ( upto 132kV essential).
* Build and develop a skilled operations-based design team, improve competencies for Principal Designer roles under CDM regulations, and maintain high-quality standards and training.
* Working on bespoke project from cradle to grave, including cable network, overhead lines and substation installations.
* Develop design programme
* Develop and organize team meetings regime for coordination.
* Coordinate with Substation build project manager.
* Chase for Information from external parties. Keep RFI and TQ register updated and on track.
* Keep Information received in respective folder.
* Coordinate between different Disciplines.
* Update report on CVRs.
* Chair meeting with Client and travel to Client office if required.

**The Person:**

* Experience in a design role within an electricity distribution network operator or a similar industry 10 years minimum.
* HNC or degree in Electrical Engineering/Civil engineering/protection engineering.
* Design experience or familiarity with design activities up to 132kV is must.

title: Project Delivery Specialist
description:
**Job Description**  

Project Managers serve as the single point of contact between the Operations and Commercial teams, tasked with executing our market research services from start to finish. Project Managers convert Commercial/Client analytical inputs into high\-quality survey materials, maintain project timing and scheduling systems, perform quality checks, and coordinate between internal and external stakeholders to fulfill market research project requirements.


RESPONSIBILITIES

* Review questionnaire input forms and study materials for accuracy, completeness, and logical consistency, proactively resolving any discrepancies with Commercial and Client Service teams.
* Program and configure online surveys within NIQ's proprietary survey platform using approved concepts, stimuli, and finalized questionnaire specifications.
* Coordinate translation requirements with internal and external translation partners to ensure timely delivery of localized survey materials.
* Conduct thorough quality assurance (QA) testing of programmed surveys to validate routing, logic, quotas, stimuli display, and respondent experience before launch.
* Configure survey routing solutions and vendor integrations, including setup and deployment through approved sample providers and panel platforms.
* Launch, monitor, and manage fieldwork activities, ensuring respondent quotas, timelines, and quality standards are achieved.
* Identify fieldwork risks and implement corrective actions, including onboarding additional sample sources or vendors when required.
* Track project costs and fieldwork performance to ensure studies are delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Client Service and Commercial teams during study setup and fieldwork execution.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve survey, programming, sampling, or fieldwork issues efficiently.
* Ensure all projects meet quality, compliance, and operational standards before client delivery.


ABOUT YOU


With your critical and strategic thinking abilities, you can execute market research projects to answer client business questions. As a strong communicator, you collaborate with other departments to design and implement solutions that are efficient and effective. Using time management, you lead multiple projects at one time to deliver the business’s needs. With your attention to detail, you can ensure that all projects are managed and delivered accurately to help grow the business. You are someone who values working on a diverse, inclusive team and can provide our clients with innovative solutions.

 **Qualifications**  

Graduate / Postgraduate

* Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Experience in market research operations, project management, survey programming, or related areas, 2\+ years of Relevant experience
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify questionnaire and setup issues.
* Open to work in different shifts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Openness and flexibility to change


Preferred Experience

* Experience working with survey programming platforms (no coding language experience required).
* Knowledge of sampling, quota management, fieldwork monitoring, and online panel vendors.
* Familiarity with survey routing and sample management platforms.
* Understanding of market research methodologies and online data collection processes.

 **Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

title: Program Manager, Climate Operations
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 5 years of experience with carbon accounting and methodologies or energy markets.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience in climate science, Green House Gas (GHG) Standards and accounting, or the energy industry.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience leading and executing complex strategic and operational initiatives for large organizations.
* Experience developing data\-driven insights and translating and presenting these into meaningful recommendations for multiple audiences, including the C\-Suite level.
* High\-sense of organization and oriented towards execution.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


APAC is a key region of focus for our operational and value chain decarbonization roadmap, as well as other climate\-related goals.


In this role, you will be responsible for leading strategic projects and provide clear, high\-impact analysis and deliverables that help to evolve our regional strategy and accelerate carbon reduction. As part of these efforts, you will turn strategic insights/recommendations into action by working with various stakeholders, including key cross\-functional leadership. You will partner with external experts to shape our perspective on carbon, energy, and other efforts and enable the broader decarbonization ecosystem.  

The Global Sustainability team enables Google to build a more sustainable future for everyone by driving strategy and solutions. We drive the development and implementation of Google’s global sustainability strategy to further empower action, ensure alignment and prioritization, identify leadership opportunities, and mitigate risks. We drive sustainability strategy and programs on carbon, circular economy, water, product integration, reporting, and employee engagement, while serving as a sustainability leadership advocate internally and externally.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide strategic and technical oversight for our carbon reduction, clean energy, and water strategy in APAC.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration to develop and execute strategic initiatives in pursuit of Google’s net zero and related sustainability commitments.
* Lead efforts with external experts and industry partners to drive progress on regional climate priorities.
* Manage an evolving portfolio of strategic projects and initiatives that advance the climate operations organization and enable its core objectives.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Project Manager - PMO
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

As Project Manager, you will lead large\-scale supplier development and qualification initiatives by integrating critical cross\-functional workstreams to ensure successful execution. This role is accountable for driving structured planning across supplier qualification, capacity expansion, and operational readiness while maintaining alignment, transparency, and execution discipline across internal and external stakeholders.



This role operates within a collaborative office environment and requires sufficient travel to suppliers and partner locations. Schedule flexibility may be required during critical phases of project qualification or program execution.


**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Lead large\-scale extended workbench development and qualification programs in support of strategic business priorities and long\-term operational readiness.
* Develop and govern integrated project plans that align all critical workstreams required for successful supplier qualification and program execution.
* Direct cross\-functional coordination across capacity expansion, manufacturing readiness, quality, procurement, engineering, and operations to deliver qualification milestones on schedule.
* Active engagement with in\-country supplier selection and part qualification activities to ensure alignment with technical, commercial, and operational requirements.
* Drive disciplined execution of qualification plans by actively managing risks, dependencies, deliverables, and escalation pathways across participating teams.
* Establish program governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication routines that provide clear visibility into progress, key issues, and decision points.
* Partner across internal and external stakeholder groups to remove barriers, resolve issues, and sustain momentum across complex supplier development initiatives.
* Provide leadership with strategic updates and recommendations on qualification status, supplier readiness, capacity progress, and overall program health.


**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in manufacturing and project management, including new product introduction, supplier qualification, or large\-scale expansion initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience in supplier development, operations, procurement, product development, or order management.
* Proven leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities in complex, cross\-functional environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Proficiency with project management and business tools, including Microsoft Project and PowerPoint.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities.

Our Gas Services division offers Low\-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo

* Career growth and development opportunities
* Supportive work culture

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Technical Project ManagerJob Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Project Manager** to lead and manage software development projects from planning through delivery. The ideal candidate should have a strong technical understanding, excellent project management skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with development, QA, DevOps, product, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, manage, and deliver software projects within defined **scope, timeline, and budget**.
* Coordinate with developers, designers, QA engineers, DevOps, and stakeholders.
* Define project requirements, milestones, deliverables, and timelines.
* Break projects into tasks and assign responsibilities to team members.
* Track project progress, identify risks, and resolve blockers.
* Conduct regular **stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives**.
* Communicate project status, progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.
* Manage technical dependencies and coordinate cross\-functional teams.
* Work closely with developers to understand technical challenges and requirements.
* Ensure projects follow development, testing, security, and deployment processes.
* Manage scope changes and prioritize tasks based on business requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve development and project delivery processes.
* Maintain project documentation, timelines, reports, and technical specifications.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of **software development lifecycle (SDLC)**.
* Experience with **Agile/Scrum** methodologies.
* Good understanding of web applications, APIs, databases, cloud, and software architecture.
* Experience with project management tools such as **Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar**.
* Strong communication, leadership, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, risk management, and resource management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Good to Have

* Technical background in **JavaScript, Node.js, React, Python, Java**, or similar technologies.
* Experience with **AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, CI/CD**, and DevOps workflows.
* Experience managing API integrations, AI projects, or cloud\-based applications.
* Familiarity with Git and software release management.
* PMP, Scrum Master, or other relevant project management certification.

Experience

**1–7 years** of experience in technical project management, software development, or a related field, with experience managing software development teams.

What We’re Looking For

A technically strong and organized project manager who can bridge the gap between **business requirements and technical execution**, keep teams aligned, proactively manage risks, and ensure successful project delivery.

Pay: ₹242,289\.93 \- ₹1,052,263\.23 per year

Work Location: In person
